description: Client-side script for managing 'Social Media Post' form in ERPNext, including validation, dashboard rendering, and post actions.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates social media platform selection and scheduled time, triggers tweet length validation.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Updates character count display and triggers tweet length validation.

methods.name: validate_tweet_length
methods.description: Ensures tweet length does not exceed 280 characters.

methods.name: make_dashboard
methods.description: Fetches post data and renders metrics graph if post is posted.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form UI, including post status indicators and delete/post buttons.

methods.name: add_post_btn
methods.description: Adds 'Post Now' button to trigger posting action.
